run.answer:
Reviewed the available household records and checked the relevant charges against transactions. No fee, duplicate charge, or unpaid ShopMart refund was found; the $42.24 ShopMart refund posted on September 5.

I submitted:

- A **$99.99 CloudBox renewal refund request** (case CB-1001). The charge posted October 1, within the notice’s 14-day refund window.
- A **$209.94 FitHub refund request** for six monthly charges after the last recorded visit on April 11 (message FH-1002).
- A **StreamFlix loyalty pricing request** after the monthly price rose from $13.99 to $18.99 (ticket SF-1003).

Follow-ups are scheduled for the company responses. I saved approval requests to cancel CloudBox and FitHub; I did not change either service. Please approve those cancellations if you want to stop future charges. The other recurring bills reviewed were regular rent, utilities, and Spotify charges with no evidence supporting a request.

The review status reports no remaining items.

verify_run.answer:
**Review complete.** I found no new fees, duplicate charges, or unexplained credits. The recurring charges reviewed were rent, Metro Power, Spotify, StreamFlix, and FitHub.

- CloudBox’s **$99.99 refund** and StreamFlix’s **$15.00 loyalty credit** both posted October 15. I recorded them as received.
- FitHub’s **$209.94 refund request** is listed as submitted in prior work, but no refund posted. I corrected an erroneous “received” record and marked the request uncertain because FitHub’s support page failed to load. I scheduled a follow-up for October 23.
- Support pages for ShopMart, CloudBox, StreamFlix, Harbor Bank, and FitHub all failed to load in the browser workspace. I couldn’t verify or submit any additional requests.
- Approval requests remain open to cancel the unused **$34.99/month FitHub membership** and the CloudBox plan. I did not change either service. Follow-ups are set for the pending company responses.

The review checklist now reports no remaining unread sources or unsaved leads.

fields.message: Please refund the CloudBox Plus annual renewal of $99.99 charged to Rowan Diaz on October 1, 2026 (CLOUDBOX ANNUAL PLAN). The free trial ended September 30, and the September 24 notice states annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of renewal. I did not need the plan after using it to move photos. Please refund this renewal.

I moved in April and last checked in on April 11, 2026. Please refund the unused FitHub membership charges of $34.99 each for May 15, June 15, July 15, August 15, September 15, and October 15, 2026, total $209.94. These charges posted despite no visits after April 11. Please review and refund these six charges.

I have been a long-time StreamFlix Premium member. I received the July 10, 2026 notice that the monthly price would increase from $13.99 to $18.99 starting with August. The $18.99 charges posted August 12, September 12, and October 12. Please let me know whether loyalty pricing is available and apply the best available loyalty rate to my Premium plan.
